deployments_detail.use: India's first AI-powered network spam detection: processes 1 trillion records real-time, flags ~100M spam calls & 3M SMSes/day; dual-layer protection

India's first network-based AI-powered spam detection system that flags suspected spam calls and SMS in real time and auto-activates for all customers. Uses a proprietary in-house algorithm with dual-layer filtering at network and IT layers, processing ~1 trillion records/day in 2 milliseconds. By June 2025 it had identified 48.3 billion spam calls and blocked ~320,000 malicious links. [In-house (Airtel data scientists)]
deployments_detail.value: 1 trillion records/day processed; 100M spam calls + 3M spam SMS flagged daily; 48.3B spam calls identified and 320,000 links blocked by June 2025

deployments_detail.use: AI-powered multi-tiered Fraud Detection Solution that detects and blocks malicious websites/links in real time across OTT apps, browsers, email and SMS, redirecting users away from flagged sites. Auto-enabled free for all customers; initially deployed in Haryana circle with nationwide rollout after six months of trials. [In-house (real-time AI threat detection, global threat repositories + internal database)]

AI-powered 'Fraud Alert' protection against OTP-leakage bank frauds: detects when a bank OTP arrives during a risky incoming call and warns the customer in real time to verify before consenting. Combines AI-driven intelligence with human judgment. In production in Haryana with rollout to 100% of customers. [In-house]

AI-powered speech analytics for contact-center customer service using deep-learning automatic speech recognition. Runs ASR on 84% of inbound contact-center calls to analyze agent performance and improve customer experience. [NVIDIA (NeMo, Triton Inference Server, AI Enterprise); Airtel-built ASR models]
deployments_detail.value: ASR run on 84% of inbound calls; ~30% of typical computing cost; contact centers handle 100M+ calls annually

deployments_detail.use: AI/ML-based RAN energy-saving engine that predicts cell-level traffic patterns and dynamically extends cell sleep windows during low-traffic periods to cut radio network energy consumption. Vendor-agnostic, supporting 4G and 5G; rolled out across India. Confirmed as deployed in Q2 FY26 earnings call. [Airtel with solution providers incl. Nokia]
deployments_detail.value: Energy costs ~29% of network OPEX, ~80% attributed to RAN (context); no specific savings % disclosed

deployments_detail.use: Strategic partnership with IBM to augment Airtel Cloud with AI inferencing across hybrid cloud, built on IBM watsonx and Red Hat OpenShift AI, plus IBM Power11 AI-ready servers as-a-Service for regulated industries needing data residency. Active rollout expanding availability zones and adding Mumbai/Chennai regions. [IBM (watsonx, Red Hat OpenShift AI, IBM Power11)]

Airtel's digital arm Xtelify launched an AI-powered software platform for telcos/enterprises with three layers: a Converged Data Engine (AI-led insights at scale), a Workforce Platform (real-time task streamlining), and an Experience Platform (customer-journey management). Positioned with a gen-AI-based sovereign cloud claiming up to 40% cloud-spend optimization; partners include Singtel, Globe and Airtel Africa. [Xtelify (Airtel)]
deployments_detail.value: Up to 40% cloud spend optimization (platform claim)

deployments_detail.use: Complimentary 12-month Perplexity Pro subscription offered to all 360 million Airtel customers via the Airtel Thanks app, bringing generative AI search (with access to GPT-4.1 and Claude models) to the consumer base. First Perplexity partnership with an Indian telco; live at launch. [Perplexity]
deployments_detail.value: INR 17,000 subscription value offered free to 360M customers

deployments_detail.use: Long-term strategic collaboration with Google Cloud to build and deliver generative-AI and cloud solutions to Indian enterprises, including industry-specific offerings in geospatial analytics, voice analytics (conversational apps across multiple languages), and marketing technology, plus an IoT solution for the utility sector. Presented as solutions in development with a 300+ expert managed-services center in Pune. [Google Cloud]

AI-driven optimization of Nxtra by Airtel data centers to enhance operational efficiency and optimize capex/energy utilization, targeting a 25% boost in operational productivity and 10% reduction in non-IT energy consumption. Referenced as being applied in the Q2 FY26 earnings call. [Nxtra by Airtel (in-house)]
deployments_detail.value: Target 25% boost in operational productivity; 10% reduction in non-IT energy consumption
